terms.comment: The classical word for a sack stuffed with wool, feathers or hair to lie on, a mattress or cushion (Lewis & Short). A padded mat in a gym or under a climbing wall is the same thing; that application is ours.

sources: Lewis & Short: culcita

These are names and conversational prompts, not instructions for fitting a harness, tying a knot or operating a belay. Examples are composed for conversation with the child; dictionary links document the component words, not these exact sentences or standardized modern climbing terminology.
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 124, 344.
The example sentence marked “composed” is ours.
